color_contract: All unlit. Large faces use sRGB display-encoded AgX+0.30 diffuse baked textures. Fine faces use linear COLOR_0 encoding of same display-transformed physical surface radiance. Base factor white, no texture on fine material. Three output sRGB, NoToneMapping, exposure 1, no additional lighting/AO.
hero_geometry: Same original 7 meshes/positions/triangles; material splits and per-face corner color only.
cause: UV islands narrower than texel centers, not widespread reversed normals or runtime AO.
fix: Multi-point Cycles diffuse surface baking on tiny faces, rejecting inside-solid samples; no image blur or forced white floor.
